players.product: ArF immersion, ArF dry, KrF and i-line semiconductor lithography systems (NSR series), FPD lithography systems and digital lithography systems for advanced packaging

quarterly_data.signal: Product launch (Imaging): Nikon released the Z5IIC full-frame mirrorless camera (Z mount), with the same level of performance as the Z5II (released April 2025): EXPEED 7 engine, backside-illumination CMOS sensor, AI-powered autofocus, in-camera vibration reduction of up to 7.5 stops, 4K UHD up to 60 fps and Full HD up to 120 fps video, scene modes on the mode dial (Nikon's first full-frame mirrorless camera to have them) and webcam / live-streaming use over USB.
quarterly_data.figure: 4K UHD up to 60 fps; up to 7.5 stops VR
